install: echo 'Nissan GTR Auto ERP — Cloud Agent environment setup' && if command -v supabase &>/dev/null; then echo 'Supabase CLI: available'; else echo 'Supabase CLI: not installed — install via https://supabase.com/docs/guides/cli'; fi && if command -v node &>/dev/null; then echo "Node: $(node --version)"; fi && if command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then echo "Python: $(python3 --version)"; fi
